name: hazen_field_post100ws_v2.hndarray
description: Hazen Lab field sample measurements after the 100 Well Survey (corrected 2026-11-11)

value.string_value: Replaces hazen_field_post100ws (Brick0000007). Rebuilt from the ORNL FRC sample collection log (Collected Samples sheet, updated 2019-02-08)
Corrected molecule terms for K, U, Ga, As, Ag, Cl and Pb; values written in scientific notation, which the earlier brick stored 1e5 to 1e6 too large, are now correct

Left out: metals of the 18 time-series samples of 2015-01-05 to 2015-01-12 (attached to the wrong wells in the log); metals of GW458-12-1-14 and FW303-12-9-14 (copies of other rows); DOC of FW301-1-5-15 (copy of DIC); Bi, Cs and U of the 2014-2015 time series and Be, Sr, U and Zn of the 2015-03-31 samples (the same floor value in every well)
The 2017-2018 EVO injection samples of this log are not here: all their measurements are in hazen_geochemistry_evo_injection_2017

Values are at the precision of the log workbook on the ENIGMA Google Drive where a workbook row matches (the 2019 tab-separated export rounds to about five digits). Nitrate reported as 0 is stored as below detection. The specific conductivity of GW456-12-15-14 (1.217 uS/cm; 220 to 370 on the well's other dates) is left out
Dissolved organic carbon of November 2013 (15 to 20 mg/L) is as reported; it tracks dissolved inorganic carbon and is about 100 times the 2014-2015 values at the same wells
FW106-061015 was logged as ranges; midpoints are stored
CO2, CH4 and CO are in micromolar: the log heads the columns 'CO2', 'CH4 umol' and 'CO umol', and umol is read as micromolar
